root_cause: Test case me intentionally galat assertion likha gaya hai jo actual response se match nahi karta
explanation: Test file me health endpoint ka response check kar rahe hain. Application 'healthy' status return kar rahi hai jo sahi hai, lekin test me expectation 'broken' rakhi gayi hai. Commit message bhi confirm karta hai ki ye intentionally break kiya gaya hai. Test line 16 pe fail ho raha hai kyunki assert response.get_json()['status'] == 'broken' likh rakha hai jabki actual response me 'healthy' aa raha hai.
suggested_fix: tests/test_app.py file ki line 16 me assertion ko fix karo: 'assert response.get_json()["status"] == "healthy"' likho 'broken' ki jagah. Ya phir agar intentionally test break karna tha to application code me status ko 'broken' return karo, lekin ye production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
